subject: End-of-quarter: quick check on priority and budget
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sethi <priya@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery follow-up + next steps

Hi Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs: lower latency inference for patient-facing chat, predictable cost for high-volume scheduling flows, and SOC2-aligned data controls for PHI.
- Proposed config: Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) with prefix caching + inference quantization; estimate 40% token-cost reduction vs your current setup.
- Ask from Luma: confirm cardinality of concurrent requests (you mentioned ~100 p95), and whether procurement requires an MPA or PO-first engagement.

Next steps I suggested: 
1) I’ll share a price estimate + a short MPA draft (attached).
2) Marissa will send a technical onboarding checklist for your infra/security team.
3) We should align on timeline: you mentioned wanting something live before your August product push — is end of July still a target?

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-2026Q2.xlsx, mpa-draft-redwood-v1.pdf

If you’re still tracking toward July, I’ll prioritize a reserved-capacity quote and calendar time for a procurement intro. Otherwise let me know if we should plan for Q3.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

On Wed, Jun 24, 2026 at 08:10 AM Priya Sethi <priya@lumahealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the recap, Sean.
>
> We’re excited about the potential cost wins. I’ll confirm the concurrent request numbers with engineering and check with procurement about the MPA vs PO flow.
>
> Can you also share the SLA options for Dedicated? We have an uptime target for external patient flows.
>
> — Priya
> Director of Product, LumaHealth
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sethi <priya@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick EOQ check-in: priority for July?

Hi Priya — circling back on the note below as we head into the quarter close. I haven’t seen confirmation on concurrent request numbers or procurement preference, and wanted to check whether this is still a hard priority for Luma to land before August.

If budget/approval timing has shifted, totally understand — just want to make sure we align our Dedicated capacity availability and any Q2 commit vs Q3 plan. A couple quick options: 
- If you’re still on for July: we can fast-track a reserved capacity quote and lock a deploy slot (I’ll need procurement contact and a rough PO timing).
- If priority slipped: happy to pause the procurement conversation and re-evaluate a Q3 kickoff — we can keep the pricing/MPA draft active for when you’re ready.

Do you have 15 minutes this week to confirm? If it’s easier, reply with a one-line update and I’ll act accordingly.

Thanks,
Sean

(Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet-2026Q2.xlsx)
From: Priya Sethi <priya@lumahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumaHealth Procurement <procurement@lumahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Quick EOQ check-in: priority for July?

Hi Sean — thanks for the follow-up and for the clear options. Short update:

- We’re leaning toward delaying the procurement/production rollout to early Q3. Internal budget planning pushed against a few other initiatives for July.
- Engineering confirms concurrent p95 is closer to 80 rather than 100, so that helps tighten the cost estimate.
- Procurement asked to keep the MPA draft so legal can review; they’ll reach out if they need a redline.

Can you leave the pricing and MPA draft active and we’ll reconvene first week of July to set a Q3 target?

— Priya
Director of Product, LumaHealth
